pipelines.name: curation/flow-vs-polars-datafusion
pipelines.description: One aggregation over the benchmark corpus in DataFusion, the same one in Polars over the same files, and whether they agree — the DataFusion variant of curation/flow-vs-polars. .aggregate(

        f.sum(col("output_tokens")).alias("output_tokens"),

)

pipelines.description: Titanic: native PHP FlowAI preparation, Python visualization and Random Forest evaluation.

spec.steps:
->withEntry('PassengerId', array_get(ref('row'), 'PassengerId'))
->withEntry('Survived', array_get(ref('row'), 'Survived'))
->withEntry('Pclass', array_get(ref('row'), 'Pclass'))
->withEntry('Name', array_get(ref('row'), 'Name'))
->withEntry('Sex', array_get(ref('row'), 'Sex'))
->withEntry('Age', array_get(ref('row'), 'Age'))
->withEntry('SibSp', array_get(ref('row'), 'SibSp'))
->withEntry('Parch', array_get(ref('row'), 'Parch'))
->withEntry('Ticket', array_get(ref('row'), 'Ticket'))
->withEntry('Fare', array_get(ref('row'), 'Fare'))
->withEntry('Cabin', array_get(ref('row'), 'Cabin'))
->withEntry('Embarked', array_get(ref('row'), 'Embarked'))
->select(ref('PassengerId'), ref('Survived'), ref('Pclass'), ref('Name'), ref('Sex'), ref('Age'), ref('SibSp'), ref('Parch'), ref('Ticket'), ref('Fare'), ref('Cabin'), ref('Embarked'))
->trainTestSplit('PassengerId', target: 'Survived', fraction: 0.2, seed: 42)

->imputeMissing('Age', output: 'AgeFilled', groupBy: 'Sex,Pclass', fitOn: '_split', missingIndicator: 'AgeMissing')
->imputeMissing('Fare', output: 'FareFilled', groupBy: 'Pclass', fitOn: '_split', missingIndicator: 'FareMissing')
->imputeMissing('Embarked', output: 'EmbarkedFilled', strategy: 'most_frequent', fitOn: '_split')
->withEntry('CabinMissing', when(ref('Cabin')->isNull(), lit(1), lit(0)))

->withEntry('Title', regex_replace(lit('/^[^,]*,\s*([^.]+)\..*$/'), lit('$1'), ref('Name')))
->withEntry('Deck', when(ref('Cabin')->isNull(), lit('U'), regex_replace(lit('/^(.).*$/'), lit('$1'), ref('Cabin'))))
->withEntry('FamilySize', ref('SibSp')->plus(ref('Parch'))->plus(lit(1)))
->withEntry('IsAlone', when(ref('FamilySize')->same(lit(1)), lit(1), lit(0)))
->withEntry('FarePerPerson', ref('FareFilled')->divide(ref('FamilySize'), 4, 'half_up'))
->withEntry('_ticket_train', when(ref('_split')->same(lit('train')), lit(1), lit(0)))
->withEntry('_ticket_key', hash(ref('Ticket')))
->withEntry('TicketFrequency', sum(ref('_ticket_train'))->over(window()->partitionBy(ref('_ticket_key'))))
->withEntry('TicketFrequency', when(ref('TicketFrequency')->same(lit(0)), lit(1), ref('TicketFrequency')))
->drop(ref('_ticket_train'), ref('_ticket_key'))
->oneHotEncode('Sex', 'Pclass', 'EmbarkedFilled', 'Title', 'Deck', fitOn: '_split', output: 'model_features', stateOutput: 'feature_encoder')
->labelEncode('Survived', fitOn: '_split', output: 'target_encoded', stateOutput: 'label_encoder')

pipelines.name: curation/titanic-features-datafusion
pipelines.description: Read the Titanic training split, recode sex and the title in the name, then let a notebook fill a missing age from its status group and size the family. Written for DataFusion (AW-3): it runs where AIWATCHER_QUERY_ENGINE=datafusion.

spec.steps:
df.select(
    col("row")["PassengerId"].alias("passenger_id"),
    col("row")["Name"].alias("name"),
    col("row")["Sex"].alias("sex"),
    col("row")["Age"].alias("age"),
    col("row")["Pclass"].alias("pclass"),
    col("row")["SibSp"].alias("sib_sp"),
    col("row")["Parch"].alias("parch"),
    col("row")["Fare"].alias("fare"),
    col("row")["Cabin"].alias("cabin"),
    col("row")["Survived"].alias("survived"),
)
.with_column("sex_code", f.when(col("sex") == lit("female"), lit(1)).otherwise(lit(0)))
.with_column("title", f.regexp_replace(col("name"), lit(r"^[^,]*,\s*([^.]+)\..*$"), lit(r"\1")))
.with_column(
    "status",
    f.when(col("title") == lit("Mr"), lit("mr"))
    .when(col("title") == lit("Master"), lit("master"))
    .when((col("title") == lit("Mrs")) | (col("title") == lit("Mme")), lit("mrs"))
    .when(
        (col("title") == lit("Miss")) | (col("title") == lit("Mlle")) | (col("title") == lit("Ms")),
        lit("miss"),
    )
    .otherwise(lit("rare")),
)
.with_column("outcome", f.when(col("survived") == lit(1), lit("survived")).otherwise(lit("died")))
.with_column(
    "deck",
    f.when(col("cabin").is_null(), lit("unknown"))
    .otherwise(f.regexp_replace(col("cabin"), lit("^(.).*$"), lit(r"\1"))),
)
.select(
    col("passenger_id"), col("name"), col("sex"), col("sex_code"), col("title"),
    col("status"), col("age"), col("pclass"), col("sib_sp"), col("parch"), col("fare"),
    col("deck"), col("survived"), col("outcome"),
)

pipelines.name: curation/titanic-features-duckdb
pipelines.description: Read the Titanic training split, recode sex and the title in the name, then let a notebook fill a missing age from its status group and size the family. Written for DuckDB (AW-3): it runs where AIWATCHER_QUERY_ENGINE=duckdb.

spec.steps:
df.select(
    ColumnExpression("row", "PassengerId").alias("passenger_id"),
    ColumnExpression("row", "Name").alias("name"),
    ColumnExpression("row", "Sex").alias("sex"),
    ColumnExpression("row", "Age").alias("age"),
    ColumnExpression("row", "Pclass").alias("pclass"),
    ColumnExpression("row", "SibSp").alias("sib_sp"),
    ColumnExpression("row", "Parch").alias("parch"),
    ColumnExpression("row", "Fare").alias("fare"),
    ColumnExpression("row", "Cabin").alias("cabin"),
    ColumnExpression("row", "Survived").alias("survived"),
)
.project(
    StarExpression(),
    CaseExpression(ColumnExpression("sex") == ConstantExpression("female"), ConstantExpression(1))
    .otherwise(ConstantExpression(0))
    .alias("sex_code"),
    FunctionExpression(
        "regexp_replace",
        ColumnExpression("name"),
        ConstantExpression(r"^[^,]*,\s*([^.]+)\..*$"),
        ConstantExpression(r"\1"),
    ).alias("title"),
    CaseExpression(ColumnExpression("survived") == ConstantExpression(1), ConstantExpression("survived"))
    .otherwise(ConstantExpression("died"))
    .alias("outcome"),
    CaseExpression(ColumnExpression("cabin").isnull(), ConstantExpression("unknown"))
    .otherwise(
        FunctionExpression(
            "regexp_replace",
            ColumnExpression("cabin"),
            ConstantExpression("^(.).*$"),
            ConstantExpression(r"\1"),
        )
    )
    .alias("deck"),
)
.project(
    StarExpression(),
    CaseExpression(ColumnExpression("title") == ConstantExpression("Mr"), ConstantExpression("mr"))
    .when(ColumnExpression("title") == ConstantExpression("Master"), ConstantExpression("master"))
    .when(
        ColumnExpression("title").isin(ConstantExpression("Mrs"), ConstantExpression("Mme")),
        ConstantExpression("mrs"),
    )
    .when(
        ColumnExpression("title").isin(
            ConstantExpression("Miss"), ConstantExpression("Mlle"), ConstantExpression("Ms")
        ),
        ConstantExpression("miss"),
    )
    .otherwise(ConstantExpression("rare"))
    .alias("status"),
)
.select(
    ColumnExpression("passenger_id"), ColumnExpression("name"), ColumnExpression("sex"),
    ColumnExpression("sex_code"), ColumnExpression("title"), ColumnExpression("status"),
    ColumnExpression("age"), ColumnExpression("pclass"), ColumnExpression("sib_sp"),
    ColumnExpression("parch"), ColumnExpression("fare"), ColumnExpression("deck"),
    ColumnExpression("survived"), ColumnExpression("outcome"),
)

pipelines.name: curation/titanic-survival-datafusion
pipelines.description: Survival rate, headcount and median age by status and class over the Titanic training split, as one DataFusion query. Written for DataFusion (AW-3): it runs where AIWATCHER_QUERY_ENGINE=datafusion.

spec.steps:
df.select(
    col("row")["Name"].alias("name"),
    col("row")["Sex"].alias("sex"),
    col("row")["Pclass"].alias("pclass"),
    col("row")["Age"].alias("age"),
    col("row")["Survived"].alias("survived"),
)
.with_column("title", f.regexp_replace(col("name"), lit(r"^[^,]*,\s*([^.]+)\..*$"), lit(r"\1")))
.with_column(
    "status",
    f.when(col("title") == lit("Mr"), lit("mr"))
    .when(col("title") == lit("Master"), lit("master"))
    .when((col("title") == lit("Mrs")) | (col("title") == lit("Mme")), lit("mrs"))
    .when(
        (col("title") == lit("Miss")) | (col("title") == lit("Mlle")) | (col("title") == lit("Ms")),
        lit("miss"),
    )
    .otherwise(lit("rare")),
)
.aggregate(
    [col("status"), col("sex"), col("pclass")],
    [
        f.count(col("survived")).alias("passengers"),
        f.avg(col("survived")).alias("survival_rate"),
        f.median(col("age")).alias("age_median"),
    ],
)
.sort(col("survival_rate").sort(ascending=False))
